audit.notes: All four views show a coherent, substantial lantern with a tiered circular base, luminous central chamber, surrounding posts, upper vent openings, domed cap, finial, and arched carrying handle. The side and three-quarter views confirm genuine depth and a constructed rear rather than a flat facade. It is visibly simplified relative to the ornate reference, but retains the reference's major structure and proportions sufficiently for clear recognition. The light-bearing lantern is a plausible interpretation of the chapter's theme of maintaining a modest guiding light or practice through uncertainty. No severe collapse or unintended intersections are visible; the edge-on handle in the side view and joined supports appear structurally intentional.
